subtitle: Mission logs from production Android systems. Each entry records the failure mode it solved, the architecture that solved it, and the telemetry that proves it.

missions.name: PulseSync
missions.summary: Multi-module collaboration platform engineered so unstable networks never produce split-brain state or lost edits.
missions.failureMode: Concurrent writes over flaky uplinks caused divergent local state; users lost offline edits and sync loops drained battery.
missions.countermeasure: Room as single source of truth, transactional outbox in the same SQLite write, deterministic conflict resolution, and delta streams with exponential backoff.

missions.name: Transitly GTFS-RT
missions.summary: Live transit arrivals ingesting 2.4M vehicle-position events daily while holding a 60fps frame budget on mid-range hardware.
missions.failureMode: Main-thread protobuf decoding and naive polling produced 4.2% dropped frames and heavy battery drain during rush-hour density.
missions.countermeasure: Off-thread GTFS-RT decode, spatial quadtree filtering, motion-adaptive poll cadence, and predictive prefetch of the rider's next two stations.

missions.name: POS Ultimate Pro
missions.summary: Retail terminal that survives cell-tower dead zones with zero cart or audit-trail loss across 100k+ monthly transactions.
missions.failureMode: Uplink drops abandoned active carts and wrote unrecoverable gaps into financial audit records.
missions.countermeasure: SQLCipher-encrypted local ledger, idempotent WorkManager queue, MVI single-state UI, and deterministic replay on reconnect.

missions.name: Lumen Player
missions.summary: Lifecycle-bound playback engine that removed scrub jank and memory spikes on 2GB-RAM devices.
missions.failureMode: Resolution switches and fast scrubbing stalled the UI thread and ballooned peak memory on low-end hardware.
missions.countermeasure: MediaSession service with off-thread frame extraction, custom surface composition, and Macrobenchmark-tuned Baseline Profiles.

missions.name: Social Pulse
missions.summary: Live multi-feed analytics surface that cut redundant recomposition by 65% under continuous socket pressure.
missions.failureMode: Concurrent metric feeds invalidated whole subtrees on every frame, causing visible hitch during chart animation.
missions.countermeasure: Immutable @Immutable state models, lambda-deferred state reads, request coalescing, and a tiered memory→DataStore→network cache.
